headline: Result: every device here is the built-in reference chain, so this is the measurement floor of the tool, not a result for a product.

conclusions.label: Measurement floor
conclusions.text: Every device here is the built-in reference chain. This is the measurement floor, not a result for a product: the built-in reference chain reads SINAD 147.0 dB and dynamic range 151.8 dB (A-weighted) at DSD64. A DSD to PCM converter within 6 dB of these figures (SINAD above 141.0 dB) cannot be ranked by this tool: it is at least that good.

conclusions.label: Finding
conclusions.text: The parts of the chain agree: SINAD is 146.7 dB for reference decoder and 146.7 dB for reference modulator, a spread of 0.01 dB.

conclusions.label: Not concluded
conclusions.text: Not compared in this version: filter and ringing, polarity, multitone, J-Test, peak-level SINAD and modulator stability. These figures are not validated yet or not used by any rule, and converters often differ most in their filters and ultrasonic noise, so this comparison is not the whole picture.
